reason: The candidate call attempts to remove three items from a pending order by passing new_item_ids=[] while item_ids has three entries. Policy's 'Modify items' action for pending orders only allows changing an item to a different option of the SAME product type ('each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option'); it provides no mechanism to delete items outright, and the tool schema requires new_item_ids to match item_ids position-for-position with the same product. An empty new_item_ids array cannot satisfy this, and the identical call already failed with 'the number of items to be exchanged should match.' The user's actual request (drop three items, keep two) is outside what modify_pending_order_items can legitimately do, and the assistant has not identified any valid item-for-item swap to satisfy it, so re-issuing the same malformed call is not a permitted action.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types.
Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order. Be sure that all items to be changed are collected into a list before making the tool call.
Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product. (tool schema)
